context.body: Prophetic figures, divine cloud, transformed appearance, fear, and exclusive attention to Jesus converge.

observations.body: A bright cloud overshadows Jesus, Moses, and Elijah; the voice repeats beloved Son language and commands the disciples to listen to him.
observations.label: The voice identifies the beloved Son: action

observations.body: Jesus shines; Peter proposes three shelters; the disciples fall afraid and later see Jesus alone.
observations.label: The voice identifies the beloved Son: response

observations.body: face shone · bright cloud · beloved Son · listen to him

payload.posture: Read Matthew 17:1–8 as jesus names the father evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The scene honors Moses and Elijah while the final command and sight center Jesus without explaining every implication.
